scene_analysis.scene_overview: A city street view of a large beige building with a flat roof and many windows, situated between two other buildings, with a construction site in front of it. The street is paved with asphalt and has white lines painted on it. A car drives down the street, while pedestrians walk along the sidewalk. The sky is overcast.
scene_analysis.buildings: The large beige building has a flat roof and many windows. It is situated between two other buildings, one of which is taller than it. The building has a construction site in front of it, with yellow barriers and fencing surrounding it. There are several cars parked along the street.
scene_analysis.materials: The building's facade is made of concrete and has a smooth texture. The ground floor has a large window with a metal grate covering it. The second and third floors have rows of windows with white frames.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are several benches and trash cans along the sidewalk, as well as a few bicycles parked against the wall.
scene_analysis.vegetation: There are a few small trees and bushes planted along the sidewalk, adding some greenery to the urban landscape.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs posted on the fence surrounding the construction site, including a sign that reads 'Construction Zone' and another that says 'Private Property'. There are also several street signs indicating the location of traffic lights and pedestrian crossings.
